To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the eggshell breaking strength is the eggshell quality parameter that is more variable during the laying period.

eggshell breaking strength is the parameter that shows the greatest variation during the laying cycle, whereas egg weight, length and eggshell lightening are the parameters with the highest variation in the egg physical attributes.

eggshell breaking strength (a parameter of eggshell quality) and color attributes (L*, a*, and a*) are highly variable throughout the entire laying cycle and are strongly correlated to the physical egg parameters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the main factors that affect egg quality during the laying cycle and could be used for the development of new egg quality indices.

a comprehensive and in-depth analysis of egg quality attributes and it could represent a useful tool for the egg industry to better understand the egg quality variability during the entire laying cycle.
the variability and relationships of egg physical and egg quality parameters throughout the laying cycle and may provide useful information for the development of a new egg quality index.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
eggshell quality is more affected than egg physical characteristics by hen age.
the eggs laid from the peak production until 39 wk of laying age are the most homogeneous and the most suitable for commercial purposes.
the variability of the eggshell quality parameters is higher than the one of egg physical attributes, and that a slight correlation between shell breaking strength and color parameters is evidenced.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the egg physical and quality attributes can be used to discriminate eggs laid at different hen ages.
the egg physical attributes are more variable and correlated than the eggshell parameters.
egg physical and egg quality attributes are highly correlated and the variability of the eggshell quality attributes is higher than that of egg physical attributes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
egg physical attributes, eggshell breaking strength percentage, and thickness are the most important factors affecting the eggshell quality.
, in order to obtain eggs of the highest quality, the egg production should not exceed 60 wk of hen age, whereas eggs produced in the first 40 wk of laying hen cycle should be preferred.

the variability in the eggshell breaking strength could be considered a good indicator of the overall variability of the eggshell quality, and that the variability in eggshell color could be considered as an indicator of the variability in egg weight.
